speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history; the combination of a non-healing, crusted lesion on your penis and another on your finger, along with your heavy smoking history and failed previous treatments, is very concerning. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (penile and acral). Given your history of non-healing lesions, heavy smoking, and lack of response to standard treatments, this is highly suspicious for malignancy.
